data.gender_notes: Minalini is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Minalini is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'mini' which means mountain, and 'lini' which means rows of jewels. This name is believed to evoke the image of a beautiful and radiant woman, symbolizing wealth, prosperity, and beauty. The name Minalini carries the meaning “Mountain of Rows of Jewels” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Minalini usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain of rows of jewels and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Furthermore, the name Minalini, with its rows of jewels, signifies the abundance and wealth that is revered in Hindu culture. It is also a name that evokes images of goddesses like Parvati, Laxmi, and Saraswati, who are associated with beauty, prosperity, and knowledge.
